definitions.download_share: Sum of downloads_30d over the projects using the library, divided by the sum of downloads_30d over the projects using any library in the same comparison group. A project using several libraries counts in each. For http the group is requests, httpx and aiohttp; for pydantic it is every project using pydantic.
definitions.project_share: Projects using the library divided by projects in the group.
definitions.http_group: Denominator for the http shares: projects using any of requests, httpx or aiohttp (http_group.projects) and their summed downloads_30d (http_group.downloads).
definitions.pydantic_group: Denominator for the pydantic shares: projects using pydantic (pydantic.users) and their summed downloads_30d (pydantic.downloads).
definitions.projects_all: Every indexed project; the http and pydantic numbers use all of them.
definitions.llm_any: Recent projects using any LLM SDK (MCP not counted), each counted once.
definitions.mcp_names: Recent projects whose code uses each of these MCP SDK names.
definitions.mcp_client: Recent projects using the MCP client API (mcp.client or mcp.ClientSession), each counted once.
definitions.recent: Latest release uploaded on or after 2025-11-13.
definitions.llm_sdks: Projects using any of: openai, anthropic, litellm, langchain, google-genai, ollama, counted once.
definitions.google-genai: Refs named google.genai or google.genai.* (module is 'google').
definitions.pydantic_v1: v1-only: uses pydantic.validator or pydantic.root_validator and no v2 validator.
definitions.pydantic_v2: v2-only: uses pydantic.field_validator or pydantic.model_validator and no v1 validator.
definitions.pydantic_both: Uses both a v1 and a v2 validator.
definitions.pydantic_v1_namespace: Uses pydantic.v1 (compatibility namespace). Counted separately; it is not v1 or v2 use.
definitions.pydantic_top_v1: Top 10 v1-only projects by downloads_30d; check them, since compat shims inflate v1.
